spec: specs/renewal-cancellation_spec.md specs/portfolio-dashboard_spec.md specs/policy-issuance_spec.md — PolicyForge Sprint 4 (branch feat/renewal-cancellation, cut from dev @ 12f95c3). Scope: renewal cycle with idempotent offers on the currently active rule version, owner pay → RENEWED, grace-period lapse per product (AC-07.1–07.6); cancellation with pro-rata refund, cooling-off, fee floor at 0.00, append-only RefundRecord and refund preview (AC-08.1–08.5, AC-08.1 = 4473.29 per premium_check.py); AC-10.3 API half (LAPSED → cancel gives 409, no refund; Sprint 3 carry-over P-6); admin portfolio dashboard API + page (AC-11.1–11.5); synthetic sample-policy seed per app_spec §9 (≥2 policies per product for customer1/customer2, 1 near renewal, 1 past expiry within grace), which AC-11.1 depends on (Sprint 3 carry-over P-11). Frontend: Renew and Cancel actions on Policy Detail (renewal offer + Pay; refund preview then confirm; Refunds tab populated), Admin Dashboard page (KPI tiles, per-product table, renewal pipeline, lapse forecast; tiles wrap under 640px), Playwright journeys (desktop + mobile) with committed visual snapshots. Carry-over security minors from the Sprint 2/3 reviews (specs/reviews/security-feat-issuance-endorsement-20261103.md): suppress the server Basic challenge (WWW-Authenticate) for SPA/API 401s so browsers never cache credentials; a fixed or sanitised problem `instance` instead of the raw request path; one shared, length- and character-bounded sanitiser for echoed unknown keys; a fixed 409/503-style problem (not a generic 500) when a policy-number sequence is exhausted. Spec gap SG-1 (sum-insured endorsements do not re-underwrite) — the planner should propose a decision for the checkpoint, not implement silently. Any spec gaps or ambiguities (e.g. AC-07.3 needs a TERM_LIFE v2 rule set: published file vs isolated test fixture; seed date relative to today vs fixed; renewal pay amount) must be listed as G-n items for the checkpoint; spec amendments go in a separate `spec:` commit before code. Constraints: root CLAUDE.md non-negotiables and folder CLAUDE.md files, incl. web/CLAUDE.md rules KD-007..KD-010 (JSON-only consumes, allow-list responses, explicit public matchers, fixed problem detail, default-deny body limit on the routed path); money BigDecimal (scale 10 intermediate, HALF_UP 2 dp) and refund/premium values must equal premium_check.py oracle; append-only terms-paid history, refund records and transitions; never edit an existing Flyway migration or published rule file; every test named AC-NN.M. Commits: generators commit locally on feat/renewal-cancellation only, TDD order (`test(red)` before `feat(green)`), explicit paths, never push (same policy as Sprints 2–3). Hard rule KD-014: run long commands (mvnw verify, npm test, Playwright webServer) in the FOREGROUND, never background-and-wait. Environment: prefix Maven with `export JAVA_HOME="/c/Program Files/Eclipse Adoptium/jdk-21.0.12.101-hotspot"; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"`. Use project agents where they fit (test-engineer for red, renewal-orchestrator-agent, premium-calc-evaluator skill, ui-designer; evaluator uses Playwright MCP).
